partition_graph_module: partition a PyTorch fx graph module across multiple accelerators using a specified partitioner config
combine_partitions_reduce_overhead: combine two partitions into one to reduce partitioning overhead and communication latency
swap_nodes_optimize_cost: swap nodes between partitions to minimize total execution latency using the KL-based algorithm
build_dag_from_partitions: build a directed acyclic graph from partitions showing input nodes, output nodes, and device assignments
partition_sparse_nn_models: partition a sparse neural network model with embedding and non-embedding nodes across devices with equal memory
